content: Audio Features: Using openSMILE BIBREF10, 1582 audio features are extracted for each utterance using the segmented audio clips from in-cabin AMIE dataset. These are the INTERSPEECH 2010 Paralinguistic Challenge features (IS10) including PCM loudness, MFCC, log Mel Freq. Band, LSP, etc. BIBREF11.
